title: Design mode and Project mode
description: Compare the focused Design view with the Project workspace in the Vector OS website sample, and learn how workspace layouts differ from Ask, Plan and Build.
html:
Home/Product/Workspace modes

One sample, two views

Design mode and Project mode

Design gives the Vector OS website sample a focused agent view. Project adds project and conversation navigation. Both layouts explore the same sample.

Layouts shown in the scripted website sample.
Design modeProject mode
A compact view centred on the agent conversation and composer.An expanded view with the project and conversation sidebar.
Keep attention on the current request and sample result.Browse sample projects and their conversations alongside the current result.
Open the sample connections menu to explore tools and statuses.Use the same sample connections while navigating the project view.

Switch the view, keep the context.

In the website sample, switching between Design and Project keeps your selected project, draft and host. Opening a different sample project is a separate action. This is browser-session behaviour; it does not demonstrate saved native project state.

Ask, Plan and Build are task modes.

Ask, Plan and Build describe the kind of task, not the workspace layout. Ask helps you understand selected context; Plan prepares a proposed change; native Build requires the applicable approval and host checks. Choosing Project does not approve a native action. Read the mode guide and selected-context guide.

Website sample The preview is interactive and scripted. Its model changes and replies do not run live AI or CAD commands. Installed work requires the Vector OS app, an available connector and a compatible build. Check connector status.
